facts.fact: Cabinet approved the Revised White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection in the week before 8 April 2026; the Department of Home Affairs says its civil registration reforms include introducing mandatory birth and death registration through digital channels, with legislative amendments still to be drafted.
facts.system: mandatory birth and death registration through digital channels

facts.fact: The Department of Home Affairs is named as the department that will draft and table the legislation implementing the Revised White Paper's civil registration reforms, including birth and death registration through digital channels (approved by Cabinet in the week before 8 April 2026).
